mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, book_id, book_index_id, sequence_no, active_seconds, accepted_seconds, daily_seconds_after, first_minute_bucket, event_count, local_date, request_hash, heartbeat_at, policy_version FROM reading_heartbeat_receipt WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND sequence_no = #{sequenceNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO reading_session (session_id, user_id, book_id, book_index_id, last_sequence, last_heartbeat_at, total_accepted_seconds, status, version) VALUES (#{session.sessionId}, #{session.userId}, #{session.bookId}, #{session.bookIndexId}, #{session.lastSequence}, #{session.lastHeartbeatAt}, #{session.totalAcceptedSeconds}, #{session.status}, #{session.version})
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, user_id, book_id, book_index_id, last_sequence, last_heartbeat_at, total_accepted_seconds, status, version FROM reading_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO reading_daily_counter (user_id, local_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{localDate})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, local_date, verified_seconds, version FROM reading_daily_counter WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND local_date = #{localDate} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_session SET last_sequence = #{lastSequence}, last_heartbeat_at = #{lastHeartbeatAt}, total_accepted_seconds = #{totalAcceptedSeconds}, version = version + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_heartbeat_receipt (session_id, user_id, book_id, book_index_id, sequence_no, active_seconds, accepted_seconds, daily_seconds_after, first_minute_bucket, event_count, local_date, request_hash, heartbeat_at, policy_version) VALUES (#{receipt.sessionId}, #{receipt.userId}, #{receipt.bookId}, #{receipt.bookIndexId}, #{receipt.sequenceNo}, #{receipt.activeSeconds}, #{receipt.acceptedSeconds}, #{receipt.dailySecondsAfter}, #{receipt.firstMinuteBucket}, #{receipt.eventCount}, #{receipt.localDate}, #{receipt.requestHash}, #{receipt.heartbeatAt}, #{receipt.policyVersion})
